chinese: 今天我们要探讨幸福与成功之间的关系
english: Today we're going to explore the topic of happiness and its relationship with success
soundmark: /təˈdeɪ wɪər ˈɡoʊɪŋ tuː ɪkˈsplɔːr ðə ˈtɒpɪk ɒv ˈhæpɪnəs ænd ɪts rɪˈleɪʃənʃɪp wɪð səkˈses/

chinese: 许多人认为成功带来幸福
english: Many people think that success leads to happiness
soundmark: /ˈmeni ˈpiːpəl θɪŋk ðæt səkˈses liːdz tuː ˈhæpɪnəs/

chinese: 但研究表明事实往往恰恰相反
english: But research shows the opposite is often true
soundmark: /bʌt rɪˈsɜːrtʃ ʃoʊz ðə ˈɒpəzɪt ɪz ˈɒfən truː/

chinese: 幸福实际上会在生活各个领域带来更大的成功
english: Happiness actually leads to greater success in all areas of life
soundmark: /ˈhæpɪnəs ˈæktʃuəli liːdz tuː ˈɡreɪtər səkˈses ɪn ɔːl ˈeəriəz ɒv laɪf/

chinese: 快乐的人更有动力更有创造力更有韧性
english: Happy people are more motivated creative and resilient
soundmark: /ˈhæpi ˈpiːpəl ɑːr mɔːr ˈmoʊtɪveɪtɪd kriˈeɪtɪv ænd rɪˈzɪliənt/

chinese: 关键是首先关注快乐而不仅仅是追求成功
english: The key is to focus on being happy first not just on achieving success
soundmark: /ðə kiː ɪz tuː ˈfoʊkəs ɒn ˈbiːɪŋ ˈhæpi fɜːrst nɒt dʒʌst ɒn əˈtʃiːvɪŋ səkˈses/

chinese: 日常小快乐可以对长期成功产生巨大影响
english: Small daily joys can have a big impact on long-term success
soundmark: /smɔːl ˈdeɪli dʒɔɪz kæn hæv ə bɪɡ ˈɪmpækt ɒn lɒŋ tɜːrm səkˈses/
